title: Multiome (GEX + ATAC)
conclusion: Singlet pairs every Multiome ATAC barcode with its GEX barcode as Cell Ranger ARC does, and its joint cell call matches ARC's at Jaccard 0.9853 vs 0.9555 for separate per-modality calls.
methods:
**Data.** 10x Multiome PBMC 10k (granulocytes sorted out), Cell Ranger ARC 2.0.0 published outputs, processed from its
GEX and ATAC FASTQs with 10x GRCh38-2024-A. Multiome PBMC 3k was used for development and is not scored.

**Singlet 1.0.0.** The GEX library goes through the standard pipeline (10x-arc-gex whitelist). The ATAC library goes
through the ATAC path with `--paired-gex <GEX run>`:
- ATAC barcodes are corrected against the ARC ATAC whitelist and translated to the gel bead's GEX barcode. The pair list
  was rebuilt from 10x public ARC per-barcode tables. Leave-one-dataset-out, it covers 100% of the called cells of each of
  7 public ARC runs.
- Cells are called with a two-dimensional mixture over GEX UMIs and ATAC fragments in peaks, the joint call ARC makes.

**Competitor.** The usual open-source route calls each modality separately and intersects the results:
- GEX cells: Singlet's GEX call, EmptyDrops (called_v2);
- ATAC cells: ArchR's default filter (≥ 1,000 fragments, TSS enrichment ≥ 4) on Chromap + SnapATAC2 fragments from the
  same FASTQs.

**Truth.** ARC's `is_cell` and its `gex_barcode` to `atac_barcode` pairs.

**Metrics.**
- Joint cell-call Jaccard with ARC: match-or-beat against the competitor.
- Barcode pairing accuracy: the fraction of ARC cells reported by Singlet whose ATAC barcode equals ARC's. This is a
  threshold rule, ≥ 0.999.

ATAC fragment, peak and QC agreement for this library is scored under `atac`. GEX counts are scored under `gex-counts`.

singlet.build_flags: CMake Release, -march=x86-64-v3; this branch merged onto prod/modality-fixes 4f110f283cd4b1bc4865d1103a08b56346027da3

tools.name: singlet
tools.params: singlet encode --reads R1 R2 [R3] --protocol 10x-atac|10x-visium; singlet x.1fq --ref-base REF --genome-dir GRCh38/GRCm39-2024-A/star_2.7.11b --exons genes.gtf --threads 16 --pipeline --output-format mtx --raw-matrix [--paired-gex GEX_RUN]

tools.name: chromap+snapatac2
tools.params: chromap --preset atac -t 16 -x GRCh38-2024-A.index -r genome.fa -1 R1 -2 R3 -b R2 --barcode-whitelist WL [--read-format bc:<window of Singlet's detected layout>] [--barcode-translate ARC pairs]; macs3 callpeak -f BED --nomodel --extsize 200 --shift -100 --keep-dup all -g hs (Signac CallPeaks); snapatac2.pp.import_fragments + metrics.tsse; cells = ArchR createArrowFiles defaults (minFrags 1000, minTSS 4)

tools.name: per-modality-calls
tools.params: GEX cells (Singlet GEX run, called_v2 = EmptyDrops) AND ATAC cells (ArchR default filter: >= 1000 fragments, TSS enrichment >= 4, on Chromap + SnapATAC2 fragments)

datasets.title: 10x Multiome PBMC 10k, granulocytes sorted out (ARC 2.0)
datasets.truth: Cell Ranger ARC 2.0.0 published joint cell calls, barcode pairs, fragments and peaks

metrics.name: Joint GEX+ATAC cell calls: Jaccard with Cell Ranger ARC

rule.rationale: half-width of the bootstrap 95% CI of the Singlet - competitor difference (200 resamples of the 12071 called barcodes): differences smaller than this are not distinguishable on this dataset

metrics.name: ATAC to GEX barcode pairing: fraction identical to ARC

rule.rationale: pairing is a fixed table lookup; any disagreement above 1 in 1,000 cells would be a bug, not noise

metrics.notes: 11894 ARC cells with a Singlet ATAC barcode

sum of main run, MACS3 + SnapATAC2

caveats: Binary: this branch (ATAC/Visium code) merged onto prod/modality-fixes, not yet part of the singlet-campaign build the other capabilities use; the results describe the code that the merge will bring.

Barcode lists (scATAC whitelist, ARC ATAC-GEX pairs, visium-v1 spots) were rebuilt from 10x public datasets (CC BY 4.0); the 737K-cratac-v1.txt bundled before this change is a copy of the 3' v2 list and matches ~1% of scATAC barcodes.
The competitor intersects Singlet's own GEX call (EmptyDrops) with the ArchR filter on Chromap fragments; STARsolo/EmptyDrops GEX calls were not run here.
